roger.accroche: Roger does not exist. His lumbago, on the other hand, is thoroughly documented.
roger.bio: House actor, born of a description and a paragraph. The bad back was not planned; it came with the suit. He has every leading role and no legal existence. What he has left: his reading glasses, his midnight-blue jacket, and a back that has seen better days.
roger.alt_portrait: Roger, casting portrait: man in his fifties, black hair, salt-and-pepper stubble, midnight-blue jacket
roger.signe_1: Single-breasted, white shirt with an open collar, never a tie. In a noir, a raincoat over it; the jacket stays visible when he takes out his glasses.
roger.signe_2: Thin dark tortoiseshell frame, kept in the inside left pocket. They only appear when he reads. Anything long he has to say, he reads.
roger.signe_3: A slight stiffness, a hand on the lower back when he stands up or climbs stairs. Nothing more.
roger.casting_intro: A generated actor is built once, then holds. Seven views under flat light, a description block repeated word for word, and two animation tests: one failed, one that worked.
roger.planche_5: The gesture: hand inside the jacket
roger.essai_rate: Animated from the description alone: the face changes, so does the hair. It is no longer Roger.
roger.essai_reussi: Animated from an already approved image: he keeps his face, hand to the lower back, then the glasses.
roger.casting_lecon: The lesson holds for all our characters: we never animate from a description, always from an image we have already accepted.
roger.filmo_vide: His first film is in production. He asked for a fee.
roger.doleances_intro: Fifteen seconds, one shot, a complaint read with his glasses on. Each grievance links to the glossary notion that explains what he is complaining about.
roger.doleances_vide: First grievance coming as soon as his voice is chosen.

contact.description: Describe your AI-generated film project: commercial, brand film, series, archives. Reply within two working days.
contact.intro: Tell us what you want to show, to whom, and by when. We reply within two working days with an honest reading of the project and, if it holds, a proposal.
contact.message_aide: The subject, the audience, the intended length, what already exists (brand guidelines, copy, references). Twenty characters minimum.

contact.aside_1: A thirty-minute call to frame things: goal, tone, length, channels. Then a quote and a schedule, stating what is generated and what is done by hand.
contact.aside_3: No data is passed to any third party other than our email delivery provider. No cookies, no trackers.
contact.merci_texte: We reply within two working days. In the meantime, the catalogue is open.
